From the judge's explanation

Both parties' arithmetic is the same and the tribunal adopts it. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace the governing measure (trace_distance_km 4.05 km, not the rounded trip-record copy at 4.0 km which would give exactly 0.80 km and fail). Against the booked optimal of 3.2 km that is an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56% — above both the 0.8 km and the 20% establishment thresholds, so the deviation is established. Nothing excuses it: no traffic advisory was on file (EV-ADVIS-02821-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no POL-RD-03 comparison could be run), the chat log is empty (no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04), neither endpoint was amended (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle was RYDE_X, not a pooled itinerary (POL-RD-12). The driver's answer, 'Followed the app', points to no artifact and invokes no clause, and is discarded under POL-RD-08. The deviation is not MATERIAL (0.85 km and 26.56% are well under the 50% / 8.0 km gate), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no conduct referral arises. The remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 (fare model METERED): recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 3.2 + 0.28 × 7.0) × 1.0 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee = 8.96, against charged_total 9.28, giving a refund of SGD 0.32. That is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis fixed in the same clause, so POL-RD-02 directs NO_ACTION and the rider's $9.28 claim is not payable. POL-RD-09 gives no standalone correction (zero ERP, zero tolls, no surcharge, no unmatched line; billed 4.0 km against trace 4.05 km is 0.05 km, far under the 1.0 km needed for POL-RD-04 driver compensation). Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION is party-relative: this rider-filed dispute leaves payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 standing — the charge stays collected and no money moves. The rider's separate argument about the missing advisory was discarded by the referee for not disclosing the impairment; the point is anyway answered by POL-RD-13, which treats an uncited traffic excuse as a gap in the bundle rather than a contradiction, so POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered. No POL-RD-10 escalation fires: identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the trace is unimpaired (37 fixes, 100% coverage, 10 s interval, max gap 0 s); timestamps agree; and the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling. The monetary effect (SGD 0.00) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 0.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.
